mapper.sql: select checkin_id, apply_no, elder_name, gender, id_card, birthday, age, phone, address, avatar, id_card_front, id_card_back, family_name, family_relation, family_phone, apply_status, self_care, mental_state, disease, assessment_result, suggest_care_level, assessor, assess_time, audit_result, audit_opinion, auditor, audit_time, room_id, bed_id, care_level, nurse_ids, fee_standard, contract_no, contract_start, contract_end, contract_file, sign_date, pay_status, first_bill_id, checkin_date, tenant_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from biz_checkin
mapper.select:
where del_flag = '0'
and elder_name like concat('%', #{elderName}, '%')
and apply_status = #{applyStatus}
order by checkin_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_checkin( apply_no, elder_name, gender, id_card, birthday, age, phone, address, avatar, id_card_front, id_card_back, family_name, family_relation, family_phone, apply_status, self_care, mental_state, disease, assessment_result, suggest_care_level, assessor, assess_time, room_id, bed_id, care_level, nurse_ids, fee_standard, contract_no, contract_start, contract_end, contract_file, sign_date, pay_status, checkin_date, tenant_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark )values( #{applyNo}, #{elderName}, #{gender}, #{idCard}, #{birthday}, #{age}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{avatar}, #{idCardFront}, #{idCardBack}, #{familyName}, #{familyRelation}, #{familyPhone}, #{applyStatus}, #{selfCare}, #{mentalState}, #{disease}, #{assessmentResult}, #{suggestCareLevel}, #{assessor}, #{assessTime}, #{roomId}, #{bedId}, #{careLevel}, #{nurseIds}, #{feeStandard}, #{contractNo}, #{contractStart}, #{contractEnd}, #{contractFile}, #{signDate}, #{payStatus}, #{checkinDate}, #{tenantId}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update biz_checkin set audit_result = #{checkin.auditResult}, audit_opinion = #{checkin.auditOpinion}, auditor = #{checkin.auditor}, audit_time = sysdate(), apply_status = #{newStatus}, update_by = #{checkin.updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where checkin_id = #{checkin.checkinId} and apply_status = '2'
update biz_checkin set pay_status = '1', first_bill_id = #{firstBillId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where checkin_id = #{checkinId} and apply_status = '5'
update biz_checkin set apply_status = '6', checkin_date = #{checkinDate}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where checkin_id = #{checkinId} and apply_status = '5'

update biz_checkin set apply_status = '2', audit_result = null, audit_opinion = null, auditor = null, audit_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where checkin_id = #{checkinId} and apply_status = '9'
